kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Aramaic אַקְלִידָא / ܐܩܠܝܕܐ (ʾaqlīdā, “key”) from Ancient Greek κλεῖδα (kleîda), accusative singular of κλείς (kleís, “key”), from Proto-Indo-European *kleh₂us (“nail, pin, hook – instruments of old use for locking doors”), from the root *(s)kleh₂w-.
s: Proto-Indo-European *kleh₂us (“nail, pin, hook – instruments of old use for locking doors”)
